blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods for brain MRI are ranked by a single score, yet that score rests on choices that are rarely reported: how each anomaly map is aligned with the reference, how and on which data the threshold is set, and which false-positive budget, metric, aggregation and lesion definition are used. We present MIRTO, an evaluation protocol that makes these choices explicit and measures their effect. It gates the geometry of every comparison with a registration check and label-free diagnostics of known power, sets thresholds on validation data alone and reports the false-positive volume actually realised on test, repeats each comparison over 15,552 defensible evaluation pipelines, and attaches paired subject-bootstrap intervals with multiplicity control. Applied to four UAD methods trained on the same healthy data and tested on 312 BraTS 2020 subjects, MIRTO showed that an axis-order mismatch between stored maps and the reference lowered a diffusion model’s voxel AUROC from 0.873 to 0.583 whilst barely moving its slice-level AUROC. Within each metric, the method explained at least 0.95 of the variance in voxel AUROC and AUPRC and 0.77 in Dice, but only 0.14 in lesion sensitivity, where the lesion definition and hit criterion dominated. A Dice advantage that was significant at validation thresholds vanished at equal realised false-positive burden, and an exact identity attributes it to threshold transfer. A training-free change to REFLECT’s latent aggregation raised Dice at equal burden by 0.052. Nine hypotheses were tested against explicit criteria; because the same cohort served to develop the protocol, all inference is exploratory.
blocks.zh: 大脑核磁共振的无监督异常检测(UAD)方法以一分排名,然而,该分数取决于很少报告的选择:每个异常图如何与参考值一致,如何和根据哪些数据设定阈值,以及使用哪些虚假的阳性预算、计量、汇总和损伤定义。 我们提出MIRTO这一评估协议,明确这些选择,并衡量其效果。 它将每次比较的几何与登记检查和无标签的已知功率诊断联系起来,单独确定验证数据的阈值,并报告试验时实际实现的假阳性体积,重复每次比较超过15,552个可防腐评价管道,并附加配对的受试对象-受试者间隔,并有多重控制。 MIRTO应用了4种UAD方法,对相同的健康数据进行了培训,并对312 BratS 2020科目进行了测试。 MIRTO显示,存储的地图和参考文献之间轴序不匹配,将扩散模型的Voxel AUROC从0.873降到了0.583,而很少移动其切片级的AUROC。 在每个衡量标准中,该方法至少解释了Voxel AUROC和AUPRC的相差0.95和Dice的相差0.77,但只解释了损害敏感性的0.14, 其中损害定义和打击标准占主导地位。 在验证阈值上具有重大优势的虱子优势在同样实现的假阳性负担下消失,而确切的身份则将其归因于阈值转移。 对REFLECT潜在汇总的无培训变化使Dice在同等负担下增加了0.052分. 根据明确的标准测试了9个假设;由于同一组人为制定协议服务,所有推断都是探索性的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) in brain MRI learns what healthy anatomy looks like and flags whatever departs from it, so that pathology can be localised without lesion annotations [ 9 , 40 ] . The field has moved quickly, from variational and context-encoding autoencoders, including our own StRegA [ 9 , 21 ] , to diffusion models conditioned on the input [ 11 , 54 , 14 , 15 ] , rectified flows that correct an image in one step [ 12 ] , and frozen foundation-model features [ 24 , 31 ] . New methods are usually introduced with a table in which they rank first.
blocks.zh: 大脑核磁共振中不受监督的异常检测(UAD)会了解健康的解剖学的外观,并标出任何脱离它的地方,这样病理学就可以被本地化而无需损伤说明[9,40]. 该字段迅速移动,从可变和上下文编码自动编码器,包括我们自己的StRegA[9,21],到以输入[11,54,14,15]为条件的传播模型,纠正了一步来修正图像的流 [12],并冻结了地基模型特征 [24,31]. 采用新方法时通常会使用它们排行第一的表格。

blocks.en: Such a table is the end of a long chain of decisions, most of which a reader never sees. Every anomaly map lives on the grid of its own preprocessing and must be brought into the space of a common reference; a threshold has to be chosen, on some data, to meet some false-positive budget; Dice can be averaged over subjects, taken as a median, or pooled over voxels; a lesion must be defined before it can be counted as found; and the models were trained on particular healthy data with particular budgets. Each decision is defensible on its own. Together they span a large space of analysis paths, and it is well documented outside imaging that a reasonable change of path can change the conclusion [ 60 , 58 , 59 ] . In biomedical image analysis, rankings of challenge entries are known to be fragile to the metric and the aggregation [ 45 , 56 ] , and choices made with sight of the test data bias the estimate of performance [ 62 , 20 ] . UAD adds failure modes of its own. Thresholds are often tuned on the test cohort; slice-level detection scores reward any map that tracks how much brain a slice contains; and simply thresholding FLAIR intensity has been reported to give better Dice than several learnt models [ 48 ] .
blocks.zh: 这样的表是一长串决定的终结,大多数是读者从未见过的. 每个异常地图都生活在自己预处理的网格上,必须带入一个共同的参考空间;必须在某些数据上选择一个阈值,以满足一些虚假的正向预算; 滴滴可以被对对象进行平均,取为中位数,也可以被集合到花瓶上; 创伤必须被定义后才能算作找到; 模型接受了特定预算特定健康数据的培训. 每一个决定都是可以自辩的。 它们共同跨越了分析路径的广阔空间,外部成像中有充分的文献证明,合理改变路径可以改变结论[60,58,59]. 在生物医学图像分析中,已知对挑战条目的排名与度量和汇总[45,56]脆弱,在看到测试数据偏差的情况下作出的选择对性能的估计[62,20]. UAD 添加自己的失败模式 。 切片水平的检测分数会奖励任何追踪一个切片包含多少大脑的地图;

blocks.en: We asked two questions, and framed each component of the answer as a hypothesis to be tested. How much of a UAD leaderboard is decided by the evaluation rather than by the model? And can a protocol make that dependence visible, catch the errors it hides, and still say something definite about the models? Our answer is MIRTO ( M ultiverse-tested, I nterval-based, R egistration-gated, T hreshold-transfer-aware evaluati O n; Fig. 1 ). Where possible, each of its four components was checked on cases in which the right answer is known (synthetic volumes, injected corruptions, random calibration splits), and each changed at least one conclusion when applied to four current UAD families trained on the same healthy data and tested on 312 BraTS 2020 subjects.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了两个问题,把回答的每个部分都设定为有待测试的假设。 一个UAD的领导板有多少是由评价而不是由模型决定的? 一个协议能让依赖性明显可见, 抓住它隐藏的错误, 并且仍然说一些关于模型的肯定的话? 我们的答案是MIRTO(M ultiverse-test, I nterval-tegistation-gated, Threshold-ters-ters-ters-ters-valate evalati O n;图1 ) 。 在可能的情况下,其四个组件都检查了已知正确答案的案例(合成体积、注入腐败、随机校准分数),每个组件在应用到四个目前接受相同健康数据培训的UAD家庭并测试到312 BratS 2020科目时至少改变一个结论。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The MIRTO protocol. Frozen anomaly maps from every method enter four components. R : one canonical reference and a repaired, gated transform per method. T : thresholds chosen on validation data alone, with the realised (not the nominal) false-positive burden, the threshold-transfer gap and a conformal per-scan guarantee. Exact identities accompany the metrics and explain how they relate. M : a multiverse of defensible evaluation pipelines. I : paired subject-bootstrap intervals with Holm adjustment inside declared families. Dashed boxes give, for each component, a failure it caught in this study (numbers from Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 图1:MIRTO协议。 从每种方法中被冻结的异常图会输入四个组件. R:一个犬形参照物和一个修复的,门形的每个方法变换. T:仅在审定数据上选择的阈值,包括已实现的(而不是名义的)虚假阳性负担、阈值转移缺口和每扫描一次的保证。 确切的身份与衡量标准相伴并解释它们之间的关系。 M:可防性评价管道的多面性。 I: 配对 主题-bootstrap间隔 与霍尔姆调整 在申报的家庭。 本研究发现,每个部件都有一个故障(数字来自第3节)。

blocks.en: 1.1 Related work
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作

blocks.en: Reconstruction-based methods train a generative model on healthy scans and read anomalies from the residual between an input and its pseudo-healthy reconstruction. Autoencoders and their variants were surveyed by Baur et al. [ 9 ] . In our earlier work, StRegA, we combined a compact context-encoding VAE with pre- and post-processing steps chosen for clinical data, and reported a Dice of 0.642 on BraTS T2 tumours against 0.522 for the best baseline [ 21 ] . Denoising diffusion probabilistic models [ 33 ] improved reconstruction fidelity but tend either to copy the anomaly or to hallucinate healthy tissue that differs from the subject. Patched diffusion [ 10 ] , automatic masking and re-sampling (AutoDDPM) [ 14 ] , implicit guidance (THOR) [ 15 ] , masked diffusion (MAD-AD) [ 13 ] , cold-diffusion restorations (DISYRE) [ 51 ] and aggregated normative diffusion (ANDi) [ 29 ] each address this dilemma differently. Kascenas et al. showed that the spatial scale and magnitude of the training noise largely determine how well denoising autoencoders and diffusion models detect anomalies, and that a denoising autoencoder trained with coarse noise is competitive with far more complex models [ 37 ] . Two lines condition the denoiser on the input itself: cDDPM conditions on a learnt encoding of the image so that the reconstruction keeps the subject’s intensity characteristics [ 11 ] , and UCAD-CDM (here UCCD) conditions on a contrastive encoder trained to be invariant to the anomaly factor [ 54 ] . REFLECT replaces iterative sampling by a rectified flow [ 44 ] in the latent space of a VAE, transporting an abnormal latent to the healthy manifold in essentially one Euler step [ 12 ] . Feature-based methods compare deep features with those of healthy references: AnomalyDINO uses frozen DINOv2 [ 53 ] patch features and nearest-neighbour distances to a memory bank [ 24 ] ; Dinomaly and Dinomaly2 reconstruct foundation-model features [ 31 , 30 ] ; SCRD4AD uses scale-aware contrastive reverse distillation [ 41 ] . IterMask3D refines masks iteratively in 3D at test time [ 43 ] . We study REFLECT, UCCD, cDDPM and AnomalyDINO, which cover one-step transport, two forms of conditioned diffusion and a training-free foundation-model memory bank.
blocks.zh: 基于重建的方法在健康扫描上培养出基因模型,并读取输入和其伪健康重建之间的残存异常. Baur等人对自动编码器及其变种进行了调查。 [9]. 在我们早先的作品"StRegA"中,我们把紧凑的上下文编码VAE与临床数据选择的前后处理步骤结合起来,并报告BratS T2肿瘤的剂量为0.642分,最佳基线为0.522分 [21]. 分辨扩散概率模型[33] 改进了重建忠心度,但往往要么复制异常,要么产生不同于主体的健康组织的幻觉. 补丁扩散[10],自动遮盖和再取样(AutoDDPM)[14],隐含指导(THOR)[15],蒙面扩散(MAD-AD)[13],冷扩散还原(DISYRE)[51]和汇总规范传播(ANDi)[29] 都不同地处理了这一难题. 卡塞纳斯等. 表明训练噪声的空间尺度和规模在很大程度上决定了自动编码器和扩散模型的去诺能如何检测出异常,而训练出粗糙噪声的去诺能自动编码器则与更复杂的模型具有竞争力[37]. 两行对输入本身附加了条件:CDDPM条件在图像的已学习编码上,以便重建能保持对象的强度特性[11];UCAD-CD(这里的UCCD)条件在被训练成对异常因子不相适应的对比编码上[54]。 REFLECT在VAE的潜在空间中用修正流[44]来取而代之的迭代采样,在基本上一个Euler步骤[12]中将异常潜入健康多倍体。 基于地物的方法将深层地物与健康参考物的地物进行对比: AnomalyDINO使用冷冻地物 DNOv2 [53] 补丁地物和离内存库最近的相邻地地物相距 [24]; Dinomaly和 Dinomaly 2重建地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地 IterMassk3D在测试时间以3D反复精炼口罩[43]. 我们研究REFLECT、UCCD、CDDPM和AnomalyDINO,它们包括一个步骤的运输、两种有条件的传播形式和一个无培训的基础模型记忆库。

blocks.en: Comparative studies have repeatedly found evaluation to be the weak link. Meissen et al. showed that thresholding FLAIR scans gives better Dice and precision-recall curves than several learnt anomaly detectors on tumour and multiple-sclerosis data [ 48 ] . Lagogiannis et al. re-ran a diverse set of methods in a common framework on several datasets and found that feature-modelling methods, many from industrial inspection, set the state of the art [ 40 ] . Two broad benchmarks unify methods across medical domains: BMAD assembles six datasets from five domains, amongst them brain MRI, and fifteen algorithms [ 6 ] , and MedIAnomaly compares thirty methods on seven datasets of five modalities, for both image-level classification and pixel-level segmentation [ 18 ] . Bercea et al. argued that the quality of the normative reconstruction, which the usual metrics ignore, governs downstream behaviour [ 16 ] . A recent multi-centre benchmark selected thresholds on separate validation scans, reported Dice from 0.03 to 0.65 across algorithms and found biases with scanner, lesion size, age and sex [ 28 ] . Myles et al. recast UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem and derived several existing scores as instances of one energy [ 50 ] . These works compare methods under a fixed protocol, or improve the scoring rule; none quantifies how much of the resulting ranking the protocol itself determines, nor checks the geometric correctness of the comparison.
blocks.zh: 比较研究一再发现评价是薄弱环节. Meissen等编. 结果表明,比起在肿瘤和多发性硬化症数据上学到的几个异常探测器,阈值FLAIR扫描提供了更好的饮食和精准回召曲线[48]。 Lagogiannis等 (英语). 在几个数据集的共同框架内重新制定一套多样化的方法,发现地物建模方法,多出自工业检查,设定了最先进的[40]. 两大基准统一了医疗领域的方法: BMAD从5个域组装了6个数据集,其中包括脑磁共振,以及15个算法 [6],Medianomaly比较了7个数据集的30个方法,包括5个模式,用于图像级分级和像素级分级[18]. Bercea等人认为,规范性重建的质量——通常的衡量标准忽视了这种质量——支配了下游的行为[16]。 近期在单独验证扫描上选定了多中心基准阈值,报告从0.03到0.65跨算法,发现有扫描仪偏差、损伤大小、年龄和性别[28]。 迈尔斯等. 将UAD重塑为巴伐利亚反向问题,并得出了数个现有分数作为一能[50]的例子. 这些作品比较了固定协议下的方法,或改进了评分规则;没有一部能够量化协议本身所决定的结果排名的多少,也没有检查比较的几何正确性.

blocks.en: Maier-Hein et al. showed that challenge rankings change with the metric and the aggregation [ 45 ] , and the Metrics Reloaded consortium catalogued metric pitfalls and recommendations [ 46 , 56 ] , including the dependence of overlap metrics on structure size [ 61 ] . Multiverse analysis [ 60 ] and specification curves [ 59 ] evaluate a conclusion over all defensible analysis paths; the many-analysts design shows how widely reasonable paths diverge [ 58 ] . Selection on the evaluation data inflates estimates [ 62 , 20 ] . Across medical imaging, Varoquaux and Cheplygina traced how biases enter at every step from data to evaluation [ 63 ] ; Christodoulou et al. found that more than half of the MICCAI 2023 segmentation papers did not assess performance variability and that only one reported confidence intervals [ 23 ] ; and a Bayesian analysis of published comparisons estimated a probability of a false outperformance claim above 5% for 86% of classification and 53% of segmentation papers [ 22 ] . In machine learning generally, data sampling, initialisation and hyperparameter choice add enough variance to change benchmark conclusions [ 17 ] . MIRTO brings these ideas to UAD and adds what segmentation by thresholding needs: an explicit operating point.
blocks.zh: 马耶-海因等. 表明挑战的排名随着衡量尺度和汇总[45]以及重新装入量子的联营集团编目的衡量缺陷和建议[46,56]而变化,包括重叠衡量尺度对结构大小的依赖[61]。 多向分析 [60] 和规格曲线 [59] 对所有可辩驳的分析路径评价一个结论;多向分析的设计显示,合理路径的差别如何广泛。 对评价数据的选择夸大了估计数[62、20]。 Varoquaux和Cheplygina在医学成像中追踪了从数据到评价的每一个步骤的偏差。 发现MICCAI 2023分会论文有一半以上没有评估性能可变性,只有一份报道了置信间隔[23];巴耶斯人对已公布比较的分析估计,86%的分会论文和53%的分会论文可能存在5%以上的虚假出会绩效索赔。 在一般的机器学习中,数据采样,初始化和超参数选择增加了足够的差异来改变基准结论[17]. MIRTO将这些想法带到了UAD,并用阈值需求来添加什么分解:一个明确的操作点.

blocks.en: Conformal risk control (CRC) chooses a threshold on calibration data so that the expected value of a bounded, monotone loss on a new exchangeable case is at most α \alpha [ 2 ] ; risk-controlling prediction sets (RCPS) [ 8 ] and Learn-then-Test [ 1 ] give control with high probability over the calibration set instead; see [ 3 ] for an introduction. We use the loss “this scan exceeds its false-positive budget”. For such an indicator loss CRC reduces to split-conformal calibration, whose coverage conditional on the calibration set follows a known Beta law [ 64 , 3 ] ; we use that law to state how often a small calibration set misses its target. Covariate-adjusted ROC analysis [ 36 ] provides the tool we use to separate anatomy from detection in slice-level scores.
blocks.zh: 组合式风险控制(CRC)选择校正数据的阈值,这样,在新的可交换案例中,受约束的单酮损失的预期值最多为α\α [2];风险控制预测集(RCPS)[8];学习-当时的试验[1]对校正设定的概率很高;见[3]导言。 我们使用损失“这一扫描超过其虚假的肯定预算”。 对于这种指标损失,CRC减少为分门别类的校正,其覆盖范围以校正为条件,遵循已知的标准。 贝塔定律[64, 3];我们用该定律来说明一个小校正设定常常会错过它的目标. 相变调整的ROC分析[36]提供了我们用来将解剖学与分片级分数的检测区分开来的工具.

blocks.en: 1.2 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.2 缴款

blocks.en: Our contribution is an evaluation protocol, the exact accounting that makes what it reports interpretable, and one method-level improvement evaluated with it; the experiments validate the protocol and apply it. 1. Registration gate and label-free diagnostics. A gate that accepts correct registrations and rejects flips, transposes and two-slice offsets, and five discordance diagnostics computable without extra labels, two of which detect injected in-plane errors with power 1.000 1.000 at a false-alarm rate of 0.05 0.05 in 30 subjects (Section 2.3 ). 2. Operating points that account for threshold transfer. Validation-only thresholds, realised rather than nominal burden, a threshold-transfer gap with an exact decomposition of any contrast into a map term and a transfer term (Identity 1 ), and a conformal per-scan burden guarantee, for which we apply the known training-conditional law of split-conformal calibration to state, from the calibration size alone, how often a calibration set misses its target (Lemma 1 ; Section 2.4 ). 3. Exact accounting of post-processing and metrics. Elementary identities, applied to UAD, that split a post-processing gain at equal burden into an effect at fixed threshold and a threshold relaxation, state exactly when deleting a component raises Dice (Identities 4 and 5 ), and decompose pooled Dice and pooled AUROC so as to explain when subject-level and pooled rankings disagree (Identities 2 and 3 ). Their value lies in what they let a reader attribute, not in their difficulty. 4. An evaluation multiverse. Ten axes of evaluation choices, flip shares read together with the size of each difference, per-metric variance shares with bootstrap intervals, and the training data as an eleventh axis (Section 2.7 ). 5. Latent aggregation for REFLECT. A training-free change to how REFLECT combines its latent channels, which raises Dice at equal burden in two independently trained models (Sections 2.9 and 3.10 ). We apply the protocol to four UAD methods and two model-free baselines. We do not claim that any method is best, nor that the inference is confirmatory: the 312 test subjects served both to develop the protocol and to test its hypotheses, so every test is exploratory (Section 2.8 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是制定评价协议,准确的核算,使其报告的内容可以解释,并用它评估一个方法层面的改进;实验验证并应用协议。 1. 注册门和无标签诊断。 一个接受正确注册并拒绝翻转、转接和双片相抵的门,以及五个不相容性诊断可计算而无额外标签,其中两个门检测飞机中注入有功率1.000 1.000的误差,30个科目的误差率为0.050.05(第2.3节)。 2. 计算门槛转移的操作点。 仅验证阈值,实现而不是名义上的负担,阈值转移缺口,将任何对比精确地分解成地图术语和转移术语(IDentity 1 ),以及符合每个扫描负重的保证,为此,我们适用了已知的分校校正的训练条件定律,从校正尺寸到状态,校正设定常常达不到目标(Lemma 1; 第2.4节)。 3. 加工后和计量的确切核算。 适用于UAD的初级身份,将同等负担的后处理收益分为固定阈值和阈值放松的效果,在删除一个组件提高Dice(标识4和5)时准确说明,并将集合的Dice和集合的AUROC分解,以便解释主题级别和集合排名不一致时(标识2和3). 他们的价值在于他们让读者的归属,而不是他们的困难. 4. 多面评价。 10个评价选择轴,翻转份额与每个差异的大小一并读取,每分量的差异份额与靴子间隔,培训数据作为第十一轴(第2.7节)。 5. 可再生能源的低级汇总。 无培训地改变REFLECT如何结合其潜在渠道,这在两个受过独立培训的模式中使Dice承担同等负担(第2.9和3.10节)。 我们把协议应用于四个UAD方法和两个无模型基线. 我们并不认为任何方法都是最好的,也不认为推论是肯定性的:312个试验对象既为制定协议服务,也为测试其假设服务,因此,每个试验都是探索性的(第2.8节)。

blocks.en: Registration gate and label-free diagnostics. A gate that accepts correct registrations and rejects flips, transposes and two-slice offsets, and five discordance diagnostics computable without extra labels, two of which detect injected in-plane errors with power 1.000 1.000 at a false-alarm rate of 0.05 0.05 in 30 subjects (Section 2.3 ).
blocks.zh: 注册门和无标签诊断. 一个接受正确注册并拒绝翻转、转接和双片相抵的门,以及五个不相容性诊断可计算而无额外标签,其中两个门检测飞机中注入有功率1.000 1.000的误差,30个科目的误差率为0.050.05(第2.3节)。

blocks.en: Operating points that account for threshold transfer. Validation-only thresholds, realised rather than nominal burden, a threshold-transfer gap with an exact decomposition of any contrast into a map term and a transfer term (Identity 1 ), and a conformal per-scan burden guarantee, for which we apply the known training-conditional law of split-conformal calibration to state, from the calibration size alone, how often a calibration set misses its target (Lemma 1 ; Section 2.4 ).
blocks.zh: 计算阈值转移的操作点。 仅验证阈值,实现而不是名义上的负担,阈值转移缺口,将任何对比精确地分解成地图术语和转移术语(IDentity 1 ),以及符合每个扫描负重的保证,为此,我们适用了已知的分校校正的训练条件定律,从校正尺寸到状态,校正设定常常达不到目标(Lemma 1; 第2.4节)。

blocks.en: Exact accounting of post-processing and metrics. Elementary identities, applied to UAD, that split a post-processing gain at equal burden into an effect at fixed threshold and a threshold relaxation, state exactly when deleting a component raises Dice (Identities 4 and 5 ), and decompose pooled Dice and pooled AUROC so as to explain when subject-level and pooled rankings disagree (Identities 2 and 3 ). Their value lies in what they let a reader attribute, not in their difficulty.
blocks.zh: 加工后和计量的精确核算。 适用于UAD的初级身份,将同等负担的后处理收益分为固定阈值和阈值放松的效果,在删除一个组件提高Dice(标识4和5)时准确说明,并将集合的Dice和集合的AUROC分解,以便解释主题级别和集合排名不一致时(标识2和3). 他们的价值在于他们让读者的归属,而不是他们的困难.

blocks.en: An evaluation multiverse. Ten axes of evaluation choices, flip shares read together with the size of each difference, per-metric variance shares with bootstrap intervals, and the training data as an eleventh axis (Section 2.7 ).
blocks.zh: 评分多相. 10个评价选择轴,翻转份额与每个差异的大小一并读取,每分量的差异份额与靴子间隔,培训数据作为第十一轴(第2.7节)。

blocks.en: Latent aggregation for REFLECT. A training-free change to how REFLECT combines its latent channels, which raises Dice at equal burden in two independently trained models (Sections 2.9 and 3.10 ).
blocks.zh: 快速汇总 无培训地改变REFLECT如何结合其潜在渠道,这在两个独立训练的模型中使Dice承担同等负担(第2.9和3.10节)。

blocks.en: Every experiment in Section 3 tests a hypothesis. Nine primary hypotheses, H1 to H9, each carry an explicit decision criterion (Table 9 ); eight secondary hypotheses predict specific effects that follow from the identities and from the primary analyses (Appendix 0.F ); and where an experiment has no decision criterion, its hypothesis is marked exploratory and judged from intervals alone. A hypothesis is called supported only if its criterion is met, and a failed criterion is reported as such. The same 312 test subjects served both to develop the protocol and to test these hypotheses, so the tests are exploratory, not confirmatory: an explicit criterion prevents a hypothesis from being bent to fit its outcome, but it cannot remove the influence of other analyses of the same cohort. Confirmation requires an independent cohort, evaluated under a pre-registered protocol in which the training set and every threshold rule are fixed. All analyses run on stored maps without a GPU; the cost of training and inference is reported in Appendix 0.D.10 .

blocks.en: IXI [ 35 ] provides T1 and T2 scans from three London sites; our preprocessed T2 pool contains the Hammersmith Hospital (HH, 3 T) and Guy’s Hospital (Guys, 1.5 T) sites. MOOD [ 65 ] provides T1 brain scans. From these we formed five training sets (Table 2 ), named after their sources, and tested every model on BraTS T2. All main-text results use IXI-HH+Guys for every method. The choice rests on two grounds stated without reference to any score: IXI-HH+Guys matches the test contrast, and IXI-HH and IXI-Guys are strict subsets of it. Because all twenty method–training-set combinations were scored on the same test cohort, the choice is protected by its stated rationale, by showing that each evaluation finding holds with every set of training data (Appendix 0.E ), and by a confirmatory evaluation on a new cohort, to be pre-registered with this training set fixed. blocks.en: Each method stores its maps in its own axis order, crop and resolution, so any comparison of methods with different preprocessing must undo these steps, and an error in doing so is easy to make and hard to see. Such errors arose in practice in assembling this benchmark. A mapping that read the stored cDDPM maps in the wrong axis order and ignored their field-of-view crop gave a voxel AUROC of 0.583; with the correct mapping the same maps gave 0.873, a change of + 0.290 ​ [ 0.277 , 0.302 ] +0.290\,[0.277,\,0.302] , with + 0.535 ​ [ 0.517 , 0.553 ] +0.535\,[0.517,\,0.553] in AUPRC and + 0.520 ​ [ 0.504 , 0.537 ] +0.520\,[0.504,\,0.537] in Dice at the validation threshold at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (Appendix 0.D.1 , Table 14 ). Slice-max AUROC moved by only + 0.112 ​ [ 0.099 , 0.125 ] +0.112\,[0.099,\,0.125] (median + 0.083 +0.083 ). This is the pattern the hypothesis predicts: a slice-level score is close to blind to the error that matters most for segmentation. The error is of the kind the registration gate is designed to reject (it fails in-plane flips and transposes on synthetic volumes; Section 2.3 ), and the label-free diagnostics flag it directly: under the wrong mapping 24% of cDDPM test subjects were anti-located (per-subject voxel AUROC < 0.5 <0.5 ). Two further instances of the same risk occurred with REFLECT. A second export of its maps with the same kind of axis error left 26% of test subjects anti-located and lowered voxel AUROC from 0.936 to 0.616 whilst slice AUROC stayed at 0.915 (with the correct mapping, 2 of 312 subjects were anti-located); and resampling REFLECT maps by simple zooming instead of with the mapped transform gave the published map a Dice of 0.089 instead of 0.548, which invalidated a comparison of score rules made with that resampling. Each error produced a plausible table. That is the case for gating geometry rather than assuming it.

blocks.en: We injected controlled corruptions into the two pipelines whose geometry had been verified independently (Fig. 4 b; Appendix Table 16 ). In-plane flips and the transpose cost UCCD 0.34 to 0.50 Dice and 0.20 to 0.26 voxel AUROC, yet changed its slice-max AUROC by at most + 0.012 +0.012 . A corrupted map can even improve a standard metric: an antero-posterior flip raised AnomalyDINO’s slice-max AUROC by + 0.181 +0.181 and the transpose by + 0.099 +0.099 . Rank stability and the anti-location rate detected every in-plane flip and transpose with power 1.000 at a false-alarm rate of 0.05 already at n = 30 n=30 , which supports H7 (Table 17 ); the secondary hypothesis on flips held as well. They behave differently elsewhere: the anti-location rate stays near zero under through-plane shifts and reference dilation, so it is specific to localisation errors, whereas rank stability reacts to almost any perturbation of the per-subject ranking (power 1.000 for a two-slice shift that moved AUROC by only + 0.003 +0.003 ) and is better read as a change detector. Permuting 5% of subject identifiers was not detectable at n ≤ 312 n\leq 312 , and the Jaccard bound was never violated. Further robustness checks (excluding the failing subject, restricting to tumours inside every field of view, a through-plane offset check, spatial randomisation and a geometry factorial) are reported in Appendix 0.D.1 .

blocks.en: 3.2 Sensitivity of rankings to evaluation choices
blocks.zh: 3.2 排名对评价选择的敏感性

blocks.en: If evaluation choices matter, the order of two methods should depend on them. H1 (ranking instability): some pair of methods takes its minority order in at least 20% of defensible universes (lower 95% bound of ϕ max \phi_{\max} at least 0.20). H2 (evaluation dominance): the evaluation axes, with their interactions with method, explain more of the variance of scores than the method does, with non-overlapping intervals. Because H2 pools metrics that live on different scales, we add an exploratory hypothesis that sharpens it: a metric measures a property of the method only if, within that metric, the method dominates the variance and the order of methods does not flip.
blocks.zh: 如果评价选择很重要,两种方法的顺序应取决于它们。 H1( 等级不稳定 ): 有些方法在至少20%的可防御宇宙中按其少数顺序排列( 下 95% 绑定为 最大\\ phi_{\max} 至少0. 20%) 。 H2(评价主导性):评价轴与方法的相互作用,比方法更能解释分数的差异,不重叠间隔. 因为H2集合的测量值活在不同尺度上,所以我们增加了一个探索性假设,使其更加精准:一个测量度量方法的属性,只有在该测量值范围内,该方法主导了差异,方法的顺序不倒.

blocks.en: 3.3 Validation thresholds and realised false-positive burden

blocks.en: A common view holds that tuning a threshold on the test cohort simply inflates Dice. H6 (test-tuning optimism): the test-matched threshold overstates Dice by at least 0.02 at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (lower bound of the transfer gap at least 0.02). Identity 1 suggests a competing account, in which the gap is a burden mismatch multiplied by a local slope, so that its sign follows that of b − β ^ b-\hat{\beta} and differs between methods; a secondary hypothesis predicted a positive gap for UCCD at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} . For the per-scan burden, H8 (conformal control): CRC keeps the test exceedance within α + 0.02 \alpha+0.02 in all 128 calibrated combinations, and Lemma 1 predicts how the exceedance is distributed over calibration sets.

For UCCD it was close to zero or negative ( − 0.008 ​ [ − 0.008 , − 0.007 ] -0.008\,[-0.008,\,-0.007] at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} ): its validation threshold almost equalled the test-matched one (0.385 against 0.381 at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} ) and was slightly liberal ( 5.3 ​ cm 3 5.3\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} realised at 5). This is exactly the pattern Eq. ( 14 ) predicts: the sign of g ¯ \bar{g} follows the sign of b − β ^ b-\hat{\beta} , scaled by the local slope of Ψ \Psi . Threshold-free metrics gave a stable order (Table 6 ). blocks.en: 3.5 Post-processing
blocks.zh: 3.5 后处理

blocks.en: Identity 5 implies that a post-processing gain measured at equal burden may come largely from relaxing the plain threshold rather than from the post-processing itself, and Identity 4 that deleting low-purity components raises Dice whilst removing small true lesions. Secondary hypotheses made this concrete: for UCCD at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} the relaxation term is positive, excludes zero and exceeds the fixed-threshold term; for AnomalyDINO the total gain is at most zero; and above-floor sensitivity falls with post-processing for UCCD and AnomalyDINO. H5 (pruning trade-off): pruning helps lesion detection at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} and hurts it at 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} .

blocks.en: 3.6 Slice-level detection
blocks.zh: 3.6 切片级检测

blocks.en: Tumours sit in large mid-brain slices, so a slice-level score may reward a map for tracking how much brain a slice contains. H9 (anatomy adjustment): if covariate adjustment removes this anatomy, a scorer that sees only brain area obtains a matched AROC within 0.50 ± 0.02 0.50\pm 0.02 . A secondary hypothesis predicts that UCCD and AnomalyDINO retain subject-specific information, with observed minus borrowed-map AROC above zero.
blocks.zh: 肿瘤坐落在大中脑切片中,所以切片分数可能会奖励一幅地图来追踪一分子所包含出多少大脑. H9 (解剖调整):如果同位素调整去除这个解剖学,一个只看到大脑区域的计分器在0.50±0.02 0.50\pm 0.02范围内获得匹配的AROC. 一个次要假设预测,UCCD和AnomalyDINO保留针对具体主题的信息,观测到的负-借出地图AROC高于零.

blocks.en: A scorer that knows only how much brain a slice contains reached a marginal slice AUROC of 0.884 ​ [ 0.869 , 0.897 ] 0.884\,[0.869,\,0.897] , within 0.025 of every residual model ( 0.887 0.887 to 0.907 0.907 ; Table 8 , Fig. 10 ). Covariate adjustment lowered the residual models to 0.73–0.77, but it did not remove anatomy entirely: at the primary caliper of 0.2 standard deviations the brain-area control still scored 0.668 ​ [ 0.654 , 0.682 ] 0.668\,[0.654,\,0.682] , so H9 was not supported, and 0.560 at 0.05. The spline-regression estimator also failed its own control (0.626 with 5 degrees of freedom, 0.719 with 8). The obstacle is positivity: tumour slices sit in large mid-brain slices, so within a subject there are few negative slices of comparable area, and matching kept only 59% of positives at 0.2 SD and 46% at 0.05 SD. The borrowed-map contrast avoids the problem by changing the scores rather than the comparison set: every model retained subject-specific information, observed minus borrowed AROC being + 0.229 +0.229 (REFLECT), + 0.266 +0.266 (UCCD), + 0.271 +0.271 (cDDPM) and + 0.124 +0.124 (AnomalyDINO), all intervals excluding zero, so the secondary hypothesis held, for the other two models as well. The marginal order (UCCD > > cDDPM > > REFLECT) also differs from the voxel-AUROC order. Intervals for every estimator and the dependence on the caliper are given in Appendix 0.D.6 .
blocks.zh: 一个只知道每片大脑包含多少的计分器在0.884 [0.869,0.897] 0.884\,[0.869,\,0.897] 每一个残基模型的0.025之内(0.887 0.887到0.907;表8,图10),到达了边缘切片的AUROC . . . . . . . . . . 斯皮克-后退估计器也未能实现自身的控制(0.626有5度自由度,0.719有8度自由度). 其障碍是正性:肿瘤切片坐落在大中脑切片中,因此在一科中,可比较面积的负切片很少,而配对时只有59%的正性保持了0.2 SD,46%的正性保持了0.05 SD. 借出-映射对比通过改变分数而不是比较集来避免问题:每个模型都保留特定主题信息,观测到的倒借的AROC为+0.229+0.229(REFLECT),+0.266+0.266(UCCD),+0.271+0.271(CDDPM)和+0.124 (AnomalyDINO),所有间隔都排除了零,因此对于其他两个模型也持有了二级假设. 边序 (UCCD > > cDDPM > > REFLECT) 也与活塞-AUROC 相异. 附录0.D.6.中给出了每个估计值的间隔和对卡利克的依赖。

blocks.en: 3.7 Lesion-level detection
blocks.zh: 3.7 连云层探测

blocks.en: If no sub-floor fragment is ever hit, the lesion floor changes pooled sensitivity only through its denominator, by the ratio | ℒ f | / | ℒ 0 | |\mathcal{L}_{f}|/|\mathcal{L}_{0}| (Appendix 0.A ). H4 (contrast dependence): detection rises with T2 contrast and with oedema fraction in every residual model. Secondary hypotheses predict that UCCD finds fewer than 10% of small lesions and that the three residual models miss largely the same lesions (Jaccard index of the missed sets of UCCD with REFLECT and with cDDPM at least 0.70).

blocks.en: The lesion definition rescaled pooled sensitivity about elevenfold through the denominator alone. REFLECT hit 287 lesions under both definitions; 287 / 472 = 0.608 287/472=0.608 with the 50 ​ mm 3 50\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} floor and 287 / 5,473 = 0.052 287/5{,}473=0.052 without, a ratio of 5,473 / 472 = 11.6 5{,}473/472=11.6 that is identical for every method because the 5,001 sub-floor fragments were never hit. Subject-mean sensitivity moved less (0.765 against 0.173). A sensitivity computed over all components is not a sensitivity in any clinical sense, and a lesion-level metric is uninterpretable without its connectivity and floor.
blocks.zh: 损伤定义仅通过分母就将集合敏感性调整了约11倍。 REFLECT在两种定义下共击中了287起损伤;287/472=0.608 287/472=0.608起,其中50毫米3 50\,\mathrm{mm}^{3}地板和287 / 5.473=0.052 287/5{,}473=0.052没有,比例为5 473/472=11.6 5{,}473/472=11.6,对每一种方法来说都是相同的,因为5 001个地底碎片从未被击中. 被主体的敏感度移动较少(0.765对0.173). 在所有成分上计算出的灵敏度在任何临床意义上都不是灵敏度,没有连通性和地层,损伤级的度量是无法解释的.

blocks.en: At the validation threshold the residual models found nearly every large lesion and almost no small one: large-lesion sensitivity was 0.915 to 0.997 and small-lesion sensitivity 0.036 to 0.073, at most 12 of 165 small lesions, as the secondary hypothesis predicted. The three residual models missed largely the same lesions (Jaccard index of the missed sets 0.805 to 0.938), which supports the second secondary hypothesis. Most misses carried evidence that the threshold did not select: of the 472 above-floor lesions, 123 to 137 were missed with in-lesion scores above the subject’s healthy-brain median, 9 to 17 had no such evidence, and 12 to 35 were selected but delineated with IoU < 0.10 <0.10 (Fig. 11 a). Lesion volume dominated detection in every model (Firth-penalised log-odds 4.8 to 6.0 per standard deviation of log volume for the residual models; Fig. 11 b), whereas in the Firth fit T2 contrast added an effect whose interval excluded zero only for REFLECT ( + 1.98 ​ [ 1.22 , 2.82 ] +1.98\,[1.22,\,2.82] ) and AnomalyDINO ( + 0.29 ​ [ 0.03 , 0.55 ] +0.29\,[0.03,\,0.55] ); for cDDPM only the GEE interval excluded zero (Appendix Table 47 ). H4 was therefore not supported; it could be tested only in part, because oedema fractions are not available in the binary labels. Label-informed upper bounds that respect the per-subject budget (Appendix 0.D.7 , Table 45 ) place the remaining headroom mainly in delineation: perfect boundaries for detected lesions would add 0.40 to 0.46 Dice at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} , an optimal threshold per lesion 0.12 to 0.16, and an optimal threshold per subject 0.03 to 0.07.

blocks.en: Thresholding raw intensity has been reported to rival learnt detectors [ 48 ] . H3 (intensity baseline): z-scored T2 comes within 0.05 Dice of at least one model at equal realised burden at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} . Identity 3 adds an exploratory prediction: a score normalised per subject, such as z-scored FLAIR, can rank voxels well within subjects yet pool poorly.

blocks.en: 3.9 Training data
blocks.zh: 3.9 培训数据

blocks.en: If the healthy training data were a neutral background to a comparison of methods, giving every method the same alternative training set should leave the contrasts between methods unchanged. And if a training set could be chosen per method from validation data, the choice should be stable under resampling of the 24 validation subjects.
blocks.zh: 如果健康的培训数据是比较方法的中性背景,那么给每一种方法提供相同的替代培训集,应该使方法之间的对比保持不变。 如果可以从验证数据中选择每套方法的培训,那么在24个验证科目的再抽样下,选择应该是稳定的。

blocks.en: Holding the evaluation fixed and giving all four methods the same alternative training set reversed a significant contrast (Fig. 13 a). REFLECT − - UCCD Dice was − 0.042 ​ [ − 0.060 , − 0.025 ] -0.042\,[-0.060,\,-0.025] with all methods trained on IXI-HH+Guys and + 0.100 ​ [ 0.079 , 0.121 ] +0.100\,[0.079,\,0.121] with all trained on MOOD+IXI, both p H < 0.005 p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005 . The method × \times training-set interaction carried 0.115 of Dice variance across the five training sets, and the four-method order differed from the IXI-HH+Guys order in 50% to 92% of defensible universes, depending on the comparison set. The MOOD+IXI comparison needs a caveat: it adds T1 data for every method, and cDDPM’s MOOD+IXI training set was 72% T1, so it compares the same sources with multi-contrast training. The comparison on IXI-HH+Guys is the clean one.

MOOD+XI比较需要注意:它为每一种方法增加了T1数据,CDDPM的MOOD+XI训练集是72%的T1,因此它将同一来源与多复式训练进行比较. 与XI-HH+Guys的比较是干净的.

blocks.en: Choosing a training set per method on 24 validation subjects was itself unstable (Fig. 13 b). The primary selection rule (median validation slice Dice) chose IXI-HH+Guys for REFLECT in only 36.8% of 10 4 10^{4} bootstrap resamples (MOOD+IXI 37.9%, MOOD+IXI-HH 22.8%), at a test regret of 0.055 Dice. Across resamples each rule produced between 27 and 137 distinct joint choices for the four methods, and the most frequent joint choice never exceeded 37.5%. Both hypotheses are therefore rejected, which is the empirical case for fixing a common training set by design, as we did. H1 and H2 held with every common training set (Appendix 0.E ). All twenty method–training-set combinations and the verdicts of the hypotheses with each set of training data are in Appendix 0.E .

blocks.en: REFLECT’s four latent channels need not agree on where an anomaly lies, and its published map averages them. If their disagreement carries signal, aggregating the channels by it should sharpen the map and raise Dice at equal burden. The median absolute deviation across channels (MAD) is retained as the recommended aggregation only if its interval does not overlap that of the best other aggregation.

blocks.en: Replacing REFLECT’s published map by the fusion of Eq. ( 27 ) raised Dice at equal burden in two independently trained models (Fig. 14 ). At 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} with cohort matching, the MAD aggregation improved on the published map by + 0.052 ​ [ 0.045 , 0.058 ] +0.052\,[0.045,\,0.058] for REFLECT trained on IXI-HH+Guys and by + 0.038 ​ [ 0.033 , 0.043 ] +0.038\,[0.033,\,0.043] for REFLECT trained on MOOD+IXI; every latent aggregation improved it in both models; scoring with the latent stream alone hurt ( − 0.063 -0.063 and − 0.073 -0.073 ); and the image stream alone beat the published fusion ( + 0.016 +0.016 , + 0.014 +0.014 ). At its own validation threshold, which is what a user would obtain, MAD reached 0.544 ​ [ 0.521 , 0.566 ] 0.544\,[0.521,\,0.566] (median 0.597) at 15.3 ​ cm 3 15.3\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} realised burden against 0.492 ​ [ 0.468 , 0.516 ] 0.492\,[0.468,\,0.516] for the published map (median 0.542) at 15.7 ​ cm 3 15.7\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (on the 0.01 threshold grid used for this study, hence the small difference from Table 4 ), with above-floor sensitivity 0.631 against 0.606. The retention criterion kept MAD ahead of the next-best aggregation in 10 of 16 settings for the IXI-HH+Guys model, including the primary setting, but in only 5 of 16 for the MOOD+IXI model, where it lost the primary setting. We therefore claim the family of results (latent aggregation helps, latent-only scoring hurts, the image stream beats the published fusion), not MAD in particular. The hypothesis is thus supported for latent aggregation as a family but not for MAD as a unique choice. blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The same four models produced different winners in four distinct ways. The metric decides whether REFLECT or a conditioned diffusion model leads. The aggregation decides it again at a fixed budget, and Identity 2 explains the direction. The operating point turns an advantage of UCCD over cDDPM that is significant after Holm adjustment into nothing once both are held to the same realised burden, and Identity 1 accounts for the whole difference as a difference in threshold transfer. And the training data, changed in the same way for every method, reverses a significant contrast. None of these is exotic. Each corresponds to a decision that a typical UAD paper takes once, silently, and reports as though it were not a decision at all.
blocks.zh: 同样的四个模式以四个不同的方式产生了不同的赢家. 衡量尺度决定是REFLECT还是有条件的传播模型领先. 汇总在固定预算中再次决定,身份2解释了方向. 操作点将UCCD相对于CDDPM的优势转换为Holm调整后的重大优势,一旦两者被控制在同一已实现的负担上,则将它变为一无所有,身份1则将整个差异作为阈值转移的差异。 而训练数据,每一种方法都以同样的方式变化,反转了显著的对比. 没有一个是异国情调。 每个文件都符合一个典型的UAD文件一次无声地作出的决定,并报告它似乎根本不是决定。

blocks.en: Registration gating is the least visible component and, in this study, the one with the largest single effect: an axis-order mismatch cut a diffusion model’s voxel AUROC from 0.873 to 0.583, whilst slice-level AUROC, a widely reported detection metric, barely changed. Such mismatches are not peculiar to one pipeline; three arose in assembling this benchmark, each yielding a plausible table. Any evaluation that compares methods with different preprocessing must map their outputs into a common space, and slice-level scores are invariant to precisely the in-plane permutations that wreck localisation. The registration gate and the label-free diagnostics catch such errors with measured power and leave correct pipelines alone; the obvious alternative, a Dice threshold on the method’s own reference, would have rejected up to 242 correctly registered subjects per method.
blocks.zh: 登记标记是最不可见的组成部分,在本研究中,最大的单一效果是:轴序不匹配将扩散模型的活性AUROC从0.873切入到0.583,而片状AUROC这个广泛报告的检测指标几乎没有改变。 这种不匹配并非一个管道所特有的;在编组这一基准时产生了三个,每个基准都得出一个可信的表格。 任何将方法与不同的预处理进行比较的评价,必须将其输出映射到一个共同的空间,而切片级分数对精确地破坏本地化的平面平面平面布局来说是无法变化的. 登记闸门和无标签诊断用测量功率捕获这种错误,而只留下正确的管道;显然的替代办法是,在方法本身的参考中设定了Dice阈值,但每个方法的正确登记对象将被拒绝多达242个。

blocks.en: The threshold-transfer component turns a familiar complaint, that thresholds are tuned on the test set, into something measurable. Identity 1 shows that the gap between test-tuned and validation-tuned Dice is not a fixed optimism to be subtracted but a product of a burden mismatch and a local slope, which differs from method to method. A comparison at validation thresholds reflects what a user would obtain but confounds map quality with threshold transfer; a comparison at equal burden isolates map quality but cannot be reproduced in practice. MIRTO reports both, and the identity says exactly how they relate. Conformal risk control adds a per-scan guarantee, which is closer to what matters for an individual patient than a cohort mean. The known training-conditional law of Lemma 1 adds the caveat that a 24-subject calibration set honours the guarantee only on average, with a spread that follows from the calibration size alone, and the empirical splits followed that law closely (shares within 2.8 percentage points, 97.5th percentiles within 0.015). A user who needs the guarantee for the calibration set in hand should use RCPS or Learn-then-Test [ 8 , 1 ] and accept a stricter threshold.
blocks.zh: 阈值转移组件将一个熟悉的抱怨,即阈值被调用在测试集上,变成了可以衡量的东西. 身份 1 显示测试调试和验证调试的Dice之间的空隙并不是一个可以被去掉的固定乐观,而是负担不匹配和局部坡度的产物,不同方法不同. 验证阈值的比较反映了用户将获得什么,但将地图质量与阈值转移相混淆;同等负担的比较隔离了地图质量,但实际上无法复制。 MIRTO报告两起事件, 身份上说得很清楚, 正规的风险控制增加了每扫描一次的保证,这更接近于个人患者所重视的,而不是组别的意思. 已知的Lemma 1培训条件法还提醒说,24个科目的校准只平均遵守保证,其分数仅从校准大小就可以看出,经验的分数则紧跟该法律(在2.8分以内,在0.015分以内为97.5%)。 用户需要手定校正的保证的,应当使用RCPS或学习-当时的测试[8,1]并接受更严格的门槛.

blocks.en: The multiverse quantifies what the previous components illustrate, and it is most informative metric by metric. Pooled over metrics, the evaluation axes carry most of the variance, but mainly because metrics have different scales, and we do not lean on that share. Within a metric the picture is sharper. Rankings by voxel AUROC are a property of the method. Dice is dominated by the method in variance, chiefly because one method is far behind, yet the order of the three residual models is decided by the evaluation, with leads of several Dice points in each direction and significant contrasts on both sides. Lesion sensitivity is mostly a property of the evaluation. Reading flip shares together with the size of each difference is what separates these cases from mere closeness: UCCD and cDDPM swap places often because they are close, and their significant difference at validation thresholds is a matter of threshold transfer. Lesion-level claims deserve the least confidence unless the lesion definition, the hit criterion and the floor are stated, and our denominator identity shows that the floor alone can change sensitivity elevenfold without a single hit changing.
blocks.zh: 多向式量化了前述各部分所说明的内容,按度量计算,它最能说明问题。 综合了各种衡量标准,评估轴承着大部分差异,但主要是因为衡量标准有不同的尺度,我们不依赖这一份额。 在一个度量内,画面更清晰。 Voxel AUROC的排名是该方法的一个属性. 骰子以方法差异为主,这主要是因为一种方法远远落后,然而三种剩余模型的顺序却由评价决定,每个方向都有数个骰子分数的领先点,双方的对比显著. 莱斯通敏感度主要是评价的一个属性. 阅读翻转股份与每个差异的大小是将这些案例与单纯的近距离性区分开来的原因:UCCD和CDDPM互换位点经常是因为它们接近,它们在验证阈值上的显著差异是一个阈值转移的问题. 莱斯通级索赔最不值得信任,除非说明损伤定义、被击中的标准和下限,而且我们的分母身份表明,单是地板就可以改变敏感度11倍而不改变一次被击中的情况。

blocks.en: For authors of UAD methods we suggest a short list, which the checklist released with the code expands. Score every method against one reference on one grid, and report a registration check. Choose thresholds on data that are not the test set, and report the realised false-positive burden as a distribution (median and 95th percentile, not only the mean). Report subject mean, median and pooled Dice side by side, and when two methods swap places across evaluation choices, report by how much each leads. State the lesion definition in full. Do not report marginal slice AUROC without an anatomy control. Report paired intervals with a declared multiplicity correction. And train competing methods on the same healthy data, or say plainly that they were not.
blocks.zh: 对于UAD方法的作者,我们建议一个短列表,随代码发布的清单会扩展. 在一个网格上对照一个参考点对每个方法进行分数,并报告登记检查。 选择非测试集数据的阈值,并将已实现的假阳性负担报告为分布(中位数和95%,而不仅仅是平均值)。 报告主题平均值、中值和集合 当两种方法互换了评价选择时,报告每种方法的领先程度。 全面说明损害的定义。 没有解剖控制, 请不要报告边缘切片 AUROC 。 报告间隔与宣布的多重更正相配。 用同样的健康数据来训练相互竞争的方法, 或者说它们不是。

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks have improved UAD evaluation by enlarging and diversifying the test data [ 28 ] , by examining the normative reconstruction [ 16 ] , or by unifying many methods and datasets within one framework [ 40 , 6 , 18 ] . MIRTO is complementary. It does not propose a new dataset; it asks how much of any benchmark’s conclusion survives a change of defensible evaluation choices, and it provides the identities needed to say why a conclusion changes when it does. The same machinery could be wrapped around any of those benchmarks. It also answers, for UAD, the concerns raised for medical imaging AI in general: that performance variability and confidence intervals are rarely reported [ 23 ] , that many outperformance claims are probably false [ 22 ] , and that biases enter at every step of evaluation [ 63 ] . MIRTO adds a source of uncertainty that intervals over subjects do not capture, the choice of evaluation pipeline, and shows how large it is.
blocks.zh: 近期的基准通过扩大测试数据[28]并使其多样化,通过审查规范性重建[16],或通过在一个框架[40、6、18]内统一许多方法和数据集,改进了普遍接受评估。 MIRTO是互补的. 它没有提出新的数据集;它询问任何基准结论中有多少在合理评价选择的改变后存活下来,它提供了说明结论发生改变的原因所需的身份。 同样的机制可以包罗其中任何基准。 它对阿联酋来说,还回答了对一般医学成像AI提出的关切:性能可变性和置信间隔很少被报告[23],许多超出性能的索赔很可能是虚假的[22],在评价的每个阶段都出现偏见[63]。 MIRTO增加了一个不确定的来源,即对主体的间隔不捕捉,评价管道的选择,并显示其有多大.

blocks.en: The evidence comes from a single cohort and a single contrast. BraTS 2020 whole-tumour labels are large, conspicuous lesions, and evaluation on T2 alone limits what can be said about small or subtle pathology; the small-lesion results here are a floor, not a characterisation. The 312 test subjects served both to develop the protocol and the choice of training set and to test the hypotheses, so all inference is exploratory; explicit decision criteria keep a hypothesis from being bent to fit its outcome, but they cannot remove the influence of other analyses of the same cohort. One trained model exists per method and training set, so training-seed variance, which can be large enough to change benchmark conclusions [ 17 ] and is the most likely competing explanation for small between-method differences, is unknown. A common training set means the same source data, not the same optimisation budget, and IXI-HH+Guys is not the best training set for every method: on test it cost REFLECT 0.055 and UCCD 0.037 Dice relative to their best training sets (Appendix Table 60 ), so the comparison of methods should not be read as each method’s best attainable result. The injection study validated the diagnostics on two pipelines; their power on other architectures is assumed rather than shown. Validation-threshold intervals do not include the uncertainty of fitting a threshold on 24 subjects, which a nested resampling would add. The covariate-adjusted slice estimators failed their own control, so the borrowed-map contrast, not the adjusted AUROC, is the defensible slice-level measure. Finally, the training-free improvement to REFLECT is shown for one method and two trained models, and the specific winning aggregation did not replicate.
blocks.zh: 证据来自单一组群和单一对比. BRATS 2020全肿瘤标签是大而明显的损伤,仅对T2的评价就限制了关于小而微妙的病理学的说法;这里的细微的利子结果是一个地层,而不是个性化. 312个测试科目既有助于制定协议和选择培训套件,也有利于测试假设,因此所有推断都是探索性的;明确的决定标准使假设不会被迫适应其结果,但它们不能去除同一组人的其他分析的影响. 每个方法和训练集都有一个训练有素的模型,因此训练-种子差异是未知的,这种差异可能足够大,足以改变基准结论[17],也是方法间小差异最有可能相互竞争的解释. 共同培训集指相同的源数据,而不是相同的优化预算,九一-HH+Guys并不是每种方法的最佳培训集:在测试中,它成本为REFLECT0.055和UCCD0.037 因此,不应将方法比较视为每种方法的最佳可实现结果。 注射研究验证了两个管道上的诊断;它们在其他建筑上的功率被假定而非显示. 验证-阈值间隔不包括在24个受试对象上安装一个阈值的不确定性,一个被打入巢的再取样会增加这个阈值. 相变调整的切片估计器未能实现自己的控制,因此所借出-映射对比而不是所调整的AUROC是可防切片级的测量. 最后,对REFLECT的免费培训改进表现为一种方法和两种训练有素的模式,具体的取胜汇总没有复制.

blocks.en: The next step is a pre-registered confirmatory evaluation on an untouched cohort, with the training set and every threshold rule fixed by its protocol. Nested resampling of the validation threshold, several training seeds per method and a second pathology with smaller lesions would close the main gaps listed above.
blocks.zh: 下一步是对未受影响的群体进行预先登记的确认性评估,其培训内容及其规程确定的每一项门槛规则。 重新取样验证阈值、每种方法的几种培训种子以及第二个损伤较小的病理学将弥补上述主要差距。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: A UAD leaderboard is a statement about models and evaluation jointly. In our study the method decided rankings by voxel AUROC, whereas the evaluation decided the order of the three strongest models in Dice and in lesion sensitivity. MIRTO separates the two. It gates the geometry of the comparison with tests of known power, holds models to operating points chosen without the test set and reports what those operating points actually deliver, evaluates every conclusion over a multiverse of defensible pipelines, reading how often an order flips together with how large each difference is, and attaches paired, multiplicity-adjusted intervals to each claim. Elementary identities explain why a contrast changes between validation thresholds and matched burden, why post-processing appears to help and why pooled and subject-level rankings disagree, and a known conformal result states how often calibration on a small set will miss its target. Applied to four current UAD families, the protocol exposed a geometric error that standard metrics missed, showed which apparent differences were artefacts of threshold transfer, and still supported some definite statements for this cohort and training set: REFLECT had the highest voxel AUROC, the two conditioned diffusion models gave higher Dice at small budgets, no method found more than 12 of the 165 small lesions, and a training-free change to REFLECT’s latent aggregation raised its Dice at matched burden in two checkpoints. Reporting evaluation choices with the same care as architectures would make UAD comparisons much easier to interpret.
blocks.zh: 一个UAD领导板是一个关于模型和联合评价的声明. 在我们的研究中,该方法决定了由voxel AUROC进行排名,而评价则决定了Dice和损伤敏感性三个最强模型的顺序。 MIRTO将两者分开. 它将比较与已知功率测试的几何相接,将模型保存在没有测试集的情况下选择的操作点上,并报告这些操作点实际提供什么,通过多面可防的管道评价每个结论,读取一个命令的翻转频率与每个差异有多大,并在每个索赔中附加成对的、经过多面调整的间隔。 基本身份说明为什么验证阈值和相应负担之间的对比变化,为什么后处理似乎有帮助,为什么集合和主题级别排名有分歧,已知的符合性结果说明在小集合上校正的频率会在多大程度上错过目标. 协议应用到目前四个UAD家族中,暴露出一个几何误差,标准度量标准缺失,显示哪些明显的差异是阈值转移的手工艺品,并且仍然支持对这一组群和培训的一些明确声明:REFLECT拥有最高的Voxel AUROC,两个有条件的传播模型在小预算上给出了更高的Dice,在165个小损伤中没有发现超过12个方法,对REFLECT潜在汇总的无培训改动在两个检查站的对应负担下提高了Dice. 报告评价选择时与结构一样谨慎,将使普遍审计数据比较更容易解释。

blocks.en: Table 16 gives the bias of every headline metric under every injected corruption for both verified pipelines, and Table 17 gives the power of the rank-stability and anti-location diagnostics. Rank stability detects every geometric corruption at n = 30 n=30 , including through-plane shifts that barely change the metrics, which is why we read it as a change detector. The anti-location rate detects the in-plane errors at n = 30 n=30 and otherwise reaches a power of 0.95 only at n = 312 n=312 , for two AnomalyDINO conditions (50% identifier permutation and doubled reference volume). blocks.en: Table 56 summarises the comparison with a common training set. Within IXI-HH+Guys the methods kept their own training protocols: REFLECT trained on all 504 IXI T2 volumes of the pool (stage 1, 200 epochs; re-flow, 50 epochs); UCCD on 324 training and 81 validation volumes (encoder and diffusion model taken at their best validation loss); cDDPM on 361 training and 92 validation volumes (best validation loss at epoch 1,426 of 1,600, 2,854 optimisation steps); AnomalyDINO built its memory bank from 50 reference volumes with slice stride 2. The optimisation budget of a single method varies strongly between training sets (cDDPM: 2,854 steps on IXI-HH+Guys, 79,040 on MOOD+IXI), so effects of the training set are effects of the training data together with the protocol that came with it. One model was trained per method and training set, so variance between training runs is not estimated; it is the most plausible competing explanation for the smaller differences between methods. The ranking-instability and evaluation-dominance hypotheses were supported with every common training set ( ϕ max \phi_{\max} from 0.295 to 0.485).

blocks.en: (1) The stated description of the training data names all three IXI sites; our IXI T2 data contain no subjects from the third site (IOP), so IXI-HH+Guys comprises the Hammersmith and Guy’s sites, identically for all methods. (2) The canonical arrays are a through-plane-cropped copy (98–149 slices) of the 240 × 240 × 155 240\times 240\times 155 originals; no tumour voxel is affected. (3) The contrast-dependence hypothesis could be tested only in part, because the available labels are binary. (4) The pruning trade-off was judged from point estimates, as no interval was computed for it. (5) The stratified and matched slice-level estimators named in H9 fail their covariate-only check; the regression estimator, added as an exploratory alternative, fails as well. (6) The family of six latent-aggregation rules specified for this experiment could not be computed from the stored latents; the family reported here is exploratory. (7) A pre-specified through-plane offset check was positive for AnomalyDINO, whose voxel AUROC peaks three slices from the canonical position ( + 0.008 +0.008 ); its export was verified to be identical to the canonical data and its numbers are reported without a shift, a decision made with knowledge of the check’s result. (8) One subject fails the overlap floor of the registration gate for UCCD and cDDPM and is kept; excluding it is immaterial (Section 3.1 ). (9) No untouched BraTS 2020 subjects remain for a hold-out set, so confirmation requires a new cohort, to be evaluated under a pre-registered protocol that fixes the training set and every threshold rule.

blocks.en: Analyses used Python 3.11 with NumPy, pandas, SciPy and statsmodels, and R with lme4 for the mixed models and logistf for Firth regression. The evaluator implements every gate, diagnostic, metric and identity of Section 2 and is checked against 31 synthetic test cases, each with a known answer. Computational cost is reported in Appendix 0.D.10 .
